name: identity management systems and privileged access management software and hardware, including authentication and access control readers, including biometric readers
explanation: Controls who can sign in and what they can access.

name: standalone and embedded browsers
explanation: Displays and runs web pages as a core function.

name: password managers
explanation: Stores and fills passwords for users.

name: software that searches for, removes, or quarantines malicious software
explanation: Finds or removes malicious software.

name: products with digital elements with the function of virtual private network (VPN)
explanation: Provides a private network connection over another network.

name: network management systems
explanation: Manages or monitors network devices and connections.

name: security information and event management (SIEM) systems
explanation: Collects and analyses security events across systems.

name: boot managers
explanation: Selects and starts an operating system.

name: public key infrastructure and digital certificate issuance software
explanation: Issues or manages digital certificates and public keys.

name: physical and virtual network interfaces
explanation: Connects a system to a network through a physical or virtual interface.

name: operating systems
explanation: Provides the base system on which applications run.

name: routers, modems intended for the connection to the internet, and switches
explanation: Routes or switches network traffic, including internet connections.

name: microprocessors with security-related functionalities
explanation: This hardware category covers microprocessors with security functions.

name: microcontrollers with security-related functionalities
explanation: This hardware category covers microcontrollers with security functions.

name: application specific integrated circuits (ASIC) and field-programmable gate arrays (FPGA) with security-related functionalities
explanation: This hardware category covers ASICs and FPGAs with security functions.

name: smart home general purpose virtual assistants
explanation: Provides a general purpose voice or virtual assistant in a smart home.

name: smart home products with security functionalities, including smart door locks, security cameras, baby monitoring systems and alarm systems
explanation: This hardware category covers smart home products whose purpose includes security.

name: internet connected toys covered by Directive 2009/48/EC that have social interactive features (e.g. speaking or filming) or that have location tracking features
explanation: This hardware category covers connected toys with social interaction or location tracking.

name: personal wearable products to be worn or placed on a human body that have a health monitoring (such as tracking) purpose and to which Regulation (EU) 2017/745 or (EU) 2017/746 do not apply, or personal wearable products that are intended for the use by and for children
explanation: This hardware category covers health tracking wearables outside the named medical rules and wearables for children.

name: hypervisors and container runtime systems that support virtualised execution of operating systems and similar environments
explanation: Runs isolated operating systems or similar virtual environments.

name: firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems
explanation: Filters traffic or detects and prevents intrusions.

name: tamper-resistant microprocessors
explanation: This hardware category covers microprocessors designed to resist tampering.

name: tamper-resistant microcontrollers
explanation: This hardware category covers microcontrollers designed to resist tampering.

name: hardware devices with security boxes
explanation: This hardware category covers devices with security boxes.

name: smart meter gateways within smart metering systems as defined in Article 2, point (23) of Directive (EU) 2019/944 and other devices for advanced security purposes, including for secure cryptoprocessing
explanation: This hardware category covers smart meter gateways and advanced security devices.

name: smartcards or similar devices, including secure elements
explanation: This hardware category covers smartcards and similar secure devices.
